newsitem.title: USA: Edison nuclear outage could go to end-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Edison nuclear outage could go to end-Feb.

text.p: Maintenance work on the 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear plant could extend the unit's outage to the end of February, a spokesman for Southern California Edison said Tuesday.
The Edison International subsidiary is the majority owner and operator of the San Clemente, Calif., nuclear plant.

The unit has been down for refueling since Nov 30 and was scheduled to restart Feb 8, but that schedule was extended last month when inspection of the unit's steam generator tubes revealed the need for more work, Edison said.
Edison spokesman Ray Golden said Tuesday the outage could continue until the end of February although "there are too many variables" for a final schedule to be set.
